body.condition: There are constants \(0<c_H<C_H<\infty\), locally uniform when \((a,b,c)\) ranges over compact exponent sets, such that \(c_H n^c\le H\le C_H n^c\).

novel.justification: A polynomial window scale distinguishes short-run, intermediate, and sustained policy summaries while the existing ordering and subset conditions enforce calendar feasibility.
